tagline: You can now invite OpenSharing recipients by email instead of exchanging a sharing identifier or credential file.
what_it_does: You can now invite OpenSharing recipients by email instead of exchanging a sharing identifier or credential file. OpenSharing emails the recipient a secure activation link to connect and read the shared data. Email sharing is in Beta.
